title: Marksmanship Hat
summary: Hat grants +1 to ranged weapon attack rolls, throws, and spell attack rolls.

fields.Marksmanship: +1 to ranged weapon and thrown attack rolls. Spell attack rolls also benefit. The reported off-hand hand crossbow exception limits the ranged weapon bonus to the main hand.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Roah Moonglow on the main floor of Moonrise Towers.
fields.Base value: 24 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
